key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued Tsunami Alert Level 3 at 21:01, ordering immediate evacuation for coastal areas of six provinces.
An estimated average of 80% of residents in surveyed barangays evacuated after the alert.
Strong shaking was felt in Pacific coastal areas, reported at intensities up to V–VII.
In parts of Guiuan, estimated tsunami travel time (~10 minutes) was shorter than the alert issuance (14 minutes post-quake), implying late warning at community level.
No significant tsunami occurred; no damages were observed, and the alert was canceled at 00:10 on 1 September 2012.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 at 08:47 pm, a magnitude 7.6 earthquake occurred near Eastern Visayas.
At 09:01 pm PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3, meaning immediate evacuation.
This included all coastal areas of Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, Leyte, Southern Leyte, Surigao del Norte and Surigao del Sur.
missing_information: Specific damaged assets or casualty figures not reported.
Most affected localities beyond named provinces are not itemized.
